feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 August 2026 7:16am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 16 August 2026 at 7:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

A declining ridge of high pressure to the southwest of Ireland.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, settling mainly west or southwest 3 or 4 late morning, then backing south or southwest late afternoon, then occasionally touching 5 this evening and at first tonight. Veering west or northwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Scattered outbreaks of light rain, becoming mainly fair for a time this afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps occasionally moderate in any rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 3 or 4, soon backing southwest, then increasing south or southwest 4 or 5 Monday evening, occasionally 6 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional patchy light rain, becoming more widespread & persistent Monday evening. Becoming mainly fair overnight into Tuesday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
